stories.title: Jamia's Malaviya Mission centre holds six-day online programme on urbanisation and sustainable development in the Global South
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia's Malaviya Mission Teacher Training Centre ran a six-day online short-term programme titled "Urbanisation and Sustainable Development in Global South" from Wednesday 7 to Tuesday 13 October, according to a university press release dated Wednesday 14 October. The release says about 108 faculty members and researchers from 22 Indian states took part, drawn from fields including architecture, planning, design, engineering, management and the sciences. It names Prof. Bharat Dahiya of Thammasat University, Bangkok, as inaugural keynote speaker and Prof. S. L. Sharma, formerly of Panjab University, as valedictory speaker, and lists some 20 other speakers. The programme was coordinated by the centre's director and a faculty member of the Department of Architecture.
stories.check: Single source (Jamia press release 6153). The release page shows no date; the 14 October date comes from the English PDF text, while the PDF file name carries 10 October. Confirm with Jamia.

stories.title: Jamia's Department of Educational Studies takes 53 students on visit to the National Human Rights Commission
stories.body: Students of the Department of Educational Studies at Jamia Millia Islamia visited the National Human Rights Commission in New Delhi on Tuesday 13 October, according to a university press release dated Wednesday 14 October. The release says 53 students took part in the visit, which ran from about 2 pm to 5.30 pm. It lists three sessions: how complaints are handled and the legal framework behind them, the work of the Commission's Investigation Division, and the ways in which complaints can be submitted. Two faculty members coordinated the visit. The university's public relations office described it as taking learning "beyond the classroom".
stories.check: Single source (Jamia press release 6154). The release page shows only the headline and no date; details and the 13 October visit date come from the English PDF. Confirm with Jamia.
